name: manifest-dev
description: Manifest-driven workflows: /define writes a verifiable Manifest, /do executes it, /ticket-up authors coherent Ticket units, /run-ticket recovers and lands one exact Ticket, and /sweep-tickets advances one Auto Ticket per scheduled invocation. /design supplies standalone design guidance from first principles: the person, the moment they meet the artifact in, and its subject set the feeling, its strength and the visual material. Implementation stays with the invoking workflow; /review-design owns artifact evaluation and its supporting checks.
